name.description: The unique and required name of this instance.

issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

userFriendlyName.description: Get the user friendly name for the LLM instance. This will be used in the UI.

llmDeployment.description: The name of the deployment to use for the llm model.

prompt.description: The {@link Genai.Prompt} that can be used to generate prompts for the LLM.

llmType.description: The type of LLM being used.

llmKwargs.description:
Keyword arguments to pass to the native LLM's interface.
Look at azureGpt35.json for an example.

uiOptions.description: Configuration for how this will be shown as a UI drop-down option

configSuffix.description:
Suffix to append to configuration names for selecting the corresponding model.
Example: 'qa_inference_config' + '_gpt4o' (where '_gpt4o' is the configSuffix).
For new models, ensure that corresponding configurations for question-answering, question-rewriting, etc. are added with the config suffix.

title: Config for how {@link Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine} should use the llm model.
name: Genai.UnstructuredQuery.Engine.ModelConfig
